## Meaning

This monitor fired because a fixed threshold was crossed.

Query:

```
avg(last_15m):abs(avg:ntp.offset{__SCOPE__} by {cluster,host}) > 15
```

**Why this threshold is a fixed number.** 15 seconds is the tolerance beyond which Kerberos, TLS and log correlation break — a protocol boundary, not a baseline.

## Impact

Observability or configuration hygiene is degraded. No direct customer impact, but our ability to see or govern the estate is reduced.

Error budget: this condition is associated with `slo-platform-services`. If the alert is sustained, expect burn-rate alerts on that objective to follow.

## Automation

Workflow `diag-host` (diagnostic only) runs automatically on every alert.

Actions: `fetch_monitor`, `host_process_list`, `disk_usage_breakdown`, `recent_host_events`.

Attached to the alert automatically: top processes, per-mount usage, host event timeline.

## Escalation

1. Owning team: `infrastructure-engineering` (see `platform/policy/teams.yaml` for the channel and ServiceNow assignment group).
2. Escalates to: `sre`.
3. Priority contract: P4 — next business day; this never pages.
